shellCommands.command: cat next.config.ts && echo "---LAYOUT---" && cat app/layout.tsx && echo "---PAGE---" && cat app/page.tsx && echo "---VERSION---" && node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version)" 2>/dev/null || grep -m1 '"next"' package-lock.json
ls node_modules/next/dist/build/templates/ 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "---PROXY SUPPORT---"; ls node_modules/next/dist/server/lib/ 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E 'proxy|middleware' | head

grep -roh "PROXY_FILENAME\|'proxy'\|\"proxy\"\|proxy\.ts" node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js node_modules/next/dist/build/index.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -20; echo "=== MATCHED FILENAMES ==="; grep -rn "MIDDLEWARE_FILENAME\|PROXY_FILENAME" node_modules/next/dist/lib/constants.js

grep -rn "nodeMiddleware\|runtime.*nodejs.*proxy\|proxy.*runtime" node_modules/next/dist/build/index.js 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo "=== config type ==="; grep -rn "proxy" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -10
(npm run dev > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 22; echo "--- waiting for ready ---"; grep -i "ready\|error" /tmp/dev.log | head
curl -s -o /dev/null localhost:3000/ ; curl -s -o /dev/null "localhost:3000/about?q=1" ; curl -s -o /dev/null localhost:3000/favicon.ico ; sleep 3; echo "=== DEV LOG ==="; cat /tmp/dev.log
CHUNK=$(curl -s localhost:3000/ | grep -o '/_next/static/[^"]*\.js' | head -1); echo "CHUNK=$CHUNK"; curl -s -o /dev/null "localhost:3000$CHUNK"; sleep 2; echo "=== TAIL ==="; tail -8 /tmp/dev.log
pkill -f "next dev" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f next-server 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; git status --short
git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig diff ==="; git diff tsconfig.json
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md && git status --short
